decisions.statement: The initiatives are read from the file the service writes and reordered here.
The panel draws the initiatives that file has as the panel comes up.
The panel draws again when that file is written and when a row is dropped.
The rows the file has are drawn unchanged but for the order a drop sets.
A color is carried on as its name.
The decoration reads that name.
A row drawn more than once is said to Alan once and named on the channel.
The badge counts every row the panel drew whatever each row is.
The initiatives drawn and the intents drawn are counted apart from each other.
No watcher on a seat file or an initiative file is registered here.
The tree view is given the drag and drop the dragging module makes.
A manual refresh reads the file again rather than waiting to be told.
The menu over a row is answered by the deleting module the panel registers.
Assigning an initiative is answered by the assigning module the panel registers.
An assignment says its words on the same channel a drop says on.
A deletion says its words on the same channel a drop says on.
A file the service has not written leaves the rows drawn as those rows are.
A drop draws the rows in their new order before the move is made.
An intent deleted is drawn away before the command deleting it answers.
An initiative deleted is drawn away with its intents before that command answers.
An intent dropped onto another initiative leaves the initiative handing that intent at once.
An intent reaches the initiative taking that intent once the service has written that intent.
A drop and a hand and a deletion and an assignment are held for an initiative in one place.
An initiative assigned is drawn in its seat's color before that command answers.
That color is the color the agents panel has for that seat.
An initiative whose seat that panel has no color for is held in no color.
A color let go is named on the channel with the seat that color was held for.
A hold remains until the file has the change held or the command is refused.
A hold is let go once every command that hold waits on has answered.
A file disagreeing after those commands answered is drawn as that file is.
A command answering draws nothing of itself.
A file with those intents in another order is drawn in the order held.
A file still holding an intent held to be going is drawn without that intent.
A file with intents other than the intents held releases the hold.
A refused move or deletion or assignment reads the file again and draws the rows that file has.
A hold for one initiative leaves every other initiative alone.
A row is deleted by the slug and the statement that row is drawn with.
A row deleted while another deletion is settling names the intent that row is drawn as.
A row dragged while a deletion is settling names the intent that row is drawn as.
How many rows the panel drew is said in the words the description module gives.
Nothing here composes the tree.
Nothing here decides a row's appearance.

definition: the Work panel brought up, and the initiatives drawn into it from one file
